vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Roar! I'm Rexy! Help me count my dino friends!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: I'll count on my fingers. Count with me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look! Who's that? A triceratops, with three horns!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Here comes a stegosaurus, with spiky plates on its back!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Whoa! A long, long neck! It's a long-neck dinosaur!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A little T-rex, just like Rexy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Another triceratops! This one is yellow.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Five! Five fingers, one whole hand!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And the littlest one... a baby dino, in its egg!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ten dinosaurs! Five in the back, and five in the front. Five and five make ten!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you show me ten fingers? Your turn!

vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Now come and see my mama's nest! Stomp, stomp!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: This nest is full. It has ten eggs. One group of ten!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's put more eggs in the next nest. Ten, and one more...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Twenty eggs! Two full nests. Two tens make twenty!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Twenty! That's a LOT of eggs!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Listen! Crack... crack... The eggs are hatching!

vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Let's count the babies by twos! Two at a time!

vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Let's play a game! Find the number on the rocks.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This one! A one, and a five. Fifteen!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: This one! A one, and a two. Twelve!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This one! A one, and a nine. Nineteen!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The numbers from eleven to nineteen all start with a one. That one means, one group of ten!

vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Oh, look! My footprints have numbers. But one number is missing!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Sixteen, seventeen... and then... nineteen. Which number is missing?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ten, eleven, twelve... and then... fourteen. Which number is missing?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's count all the way to twenty, together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Can you count to twenty, all by yourself? Go!

vo.speaker: rexy
vo.text: Great counting! Thank you for helping me, friends!
